en.headline: HKU Shanghai campus takes more than 300 students this term
en.dek: Phase two of the Zhangjiang base is in use for the new academic year, with dual-city computing programmes and planned labs with technology firms.
body: The University of Hong Kong said more than 300 students are taking classes this term at its Zhangjiang base in Shanghai's Zhangjiang Science City, after two Phase II buildings opened for the new academic year. The university said the site has received more than 1,000 students since January.

The School of Computing and Data Science is running dual-city programmes from the campus. Undergraduates on the Hong Kong-Shanghai Delta+ track spend two and a half years in Hong Kong before one and a half years in Shanghai, including an internship. Taught postgraduate students on the Delta X programme spend one semester in Shanghai. Dean Yi Ma said the arrangement lets students use Hong Kong's international setting and Shanghai's concentrated technology industry.

Local reports said the school had signed cooperation memorandums with more than a dozen artificial intelligence firms and opened joint laboratories, including in smart healthcare and embodied intelligence, so that some research and internships can take place on campus. Phase II Building 3 houses teaching space, AI laboratories and the Institute of Smart Computing; Building 5 provides sports and student activity space.

Ma said the university plans next year to move engineering and medical teaching into three further buildings in a third phase. Academic standards, the university said, are intended to match those on the Pok Fu Lam campus, with staff rotating between the two cities according to teaching and research needs.

zh.headline: 港大上海張江校園本學期逾300名學生上課
zh.dek: 張江基地二期3號及5號樓已投入新學年使用，計算與數據科學學院推行港滬雙校區課程，並與多家科技企業合作。
body: 香港大學表示，上海張江科學城基地本學期有逾300名學生上課。大學指基地自今年1月起已接待逾千名學生，二期3號樓及5號樓已於新學年投入使用。
計算與數據科學學院在當地推行「一校兩城」課程。修讀港滬科技菁英（Delta+）本科的學生先在港大本部讀兩年半，再留滬一年半並可參與企業實習；Delta X碩士生則有一個學期在上海上課。院長馬毅表示，模式讓學生同時運用香港的國際化環境與上海較集中的科技產業。
報道指學院已與十多家人工智能企業簽署合作備忘錄，並揭幕智慧醫療及具身智能等聯合實驗室，部分實習及研發可在校園內進行。二期3號樓設教研設施、人工智能實驗室及智慧計算研究院，5號樓則提供運動及學生活動空間。
馬毅表示，大學計劃明年安排工程學院和醫學院進駐第三期三座大樓。校方指上海教學學術標準與薄扶林本部一致，教職員會按教研需要往返兩地。
